scope: Independent synthetic group-policy review; no live Admin8/controller or hardware integration

cases.name: arbitrary canonical usernames inherit actual mapped groups only
legacy user lists and protected-looking account names do not elevate
custom group full ID works while display name does not
membership uses exact canonical user ID and does not fold case or prefixes
wrong object identity or type cannot supply membership
disabled or removed group revokes role in subsequent lookup
multiple groups keep highest authorized role and finite capabilities
malformed mapped group fails closed even with valid administrator membership
nested groups, mixed member types and forged suffixes do not elevate
malformed or oversized mappings invalidate complete policy
read rejection gives no role and no partial administrator result
timeout ignores late rejection without further reads or unhandled rejection
policy and normalized lists cannot mutate after validation
group resolver and existing header role capabilities stay identical
